conclusion: One existing delivery owner with event-origin variants. No new canonical module; seven source profiles extend the shared notification capability.
owner_boundary: Origin services determine clinical/event truth. Notifications owns authorized template rendering, recipient/channel selection, scheduling, attempts and delivery records. Clinical response and acknowledgement remain separate.

107.purpose: Deliver cross-domain reminders through push, SMS and email.
107.difference: Adds the explicit cross-domain medicine, appointment, vaccination, laboratory, travel and AI recommendation routing matrix to the existing channel/template lifecycle.

118.purpose: Present a unified notification inbox for medical, access, AI and emergency events.
118.difference: Preserves QR access, AI alerts and emergency events as separate origin categories. An inbox read state is not human clinical acknowledgement.

342.purpose: Notify authorized recipients of device and synchronization events.
342.difference: Preserves low battery, offline, synchronization failure, firmware update and new-measurement events. The device owner determines state; notification never performs a firmware or therapy change.

367.purpose: Notify recipients of laboratory workflow milestones and critical-result events.
367.difference: Preserves sample received, analysis started, results available and critical result separately. Laboratory authority determines criticality; delivery alone cannot close critical-result escalation.

756.purpose: Deliver pregnancy-context appointment, laboratory, ultrasound and medication reminders.
756.difference: Preserves the four distinct event sources; a pregnancy profile does not duplicate the shared notification lifecycle. Confidential content must be redacted in external previews.

1025.purpose: Deliver pediatric infection laboratory, medication, isolation and follow-up notifications.
1025.difference: Preserves isolation completion as an externally authorized event, not a timer-derived clearance. Guardian authority and confidential child/adolescent context are checked for each recipient.

4305.purpose: Deliver versioned vaccination-status notifications with jurisdiction and preference context.
4305.difference: Preserves upcoming, due soon, due, window ending, overdue, catch-up required and medical review required separately. Immunization/CDS owns those determinations; delivery configuration cannot override clinical windows or invent catch-up rules.
